q1.question: How long does it take to see results?
q1.answer: Most students report seeing meaningful progress within the first 2-4 weeks of consistent application. However, results vary based on your starting point and level of effort. Our fastest students have achieved breakthrough results in as little as 7 days.

q2.question: Is there a money-back guarantee?
q2.answer: Absolutely. We offer an unconditional 60-day money-back guarantee. If you are not completely satisfied for any reason, simply contact our support team and we will refund every penny — no questions asked.

q3.question: Do I need any prior experience?
q3.answer: No prior experience is required. The course is designed to take you from complete beginner to advanced practitioner. Each module builds on the previous one, with clear action steps at every stage.

q4.question: How is the content delivered?
q4.answer: All content is delivered through our premium online learning portal. You get instant access to HD video lessons, downloadable resources, workbooks, and our private community. Learn at your own pace, on any device.

q5.question: What if I get stuck or need help?
q5.answer: You are never alone on your journey. Our community forum is active 24/7, and our support team responds within hours. Professional and Enterprise plan members also get direct access to 1-on-1 coaching.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and payment information when you make a purchase. We also collect usage data through cookies and analytics tools to improve our service.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use your information to provide and improve our services, process payments, send important updates, and personalize your experience. We never sell your personal data to third parties.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use essential cookies for site functionality and analytics cookies to understand how you use our platform. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You may also opt out of marketing communications. Contact us to exercise these rights.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing and using our services, you agree to be bound by these terms. Please read them carefully.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By creating an account or making a purchase, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy.

purchases.title: Purchases and Refunds
purchases.content: All purchases are subject to our 60-day money-back guarantee. To request a refund, contact our support team within 60 days of your purchase. Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days.

intellectual.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual.content: All content, materials, and resources provided through our platform are protected by copyright and intellectual property laws. You may not redistribute, resell, or create derivative works without explicit permission.

limitation.title: Limitation of Liability
limitation.content: We provide our services on an as-is basis. While we strive for excellence, we make no guarantees about specific outcomes. Our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the service.
